description.value:
When 100% guaranteed success is mandatory, you can’t risk relying on hack-vulnerable smart-tech, failure prone magnetic coils, or deafening buckshot. Doubly so when hunting inner-corp traitors and spies. Thus, this rare, exquisite, near-mute, mid-caliber, bulky SMG is the typical carry for ‘saka Internal Affairs once they go loud.

Cost: 3,500eb (Luxury)

Class: Excellent Quality SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Carbine

Damage: 4d6, Drop 2 Lowest • Capacity: 50 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Drum Magazine, Improved Silencer, Power Rebuild, Short Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst. This weapon imposes a -2 penalty to Perception Checks made to hear it firing [Improved Silencer].

Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Drum Magazine, Improved Silencer, Power Rebuild, Short Scope (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 4d6, dropping the 2 lowest dice. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
